message.content:
You are building ADMIN POWER TOOLS (refunds/void/mark-paid, bulk actions + CSV export, table pagination) for the Nxeon VPS platform admin portal at /opt/nxeon. THREE other agents are editing OTHER areas concurrently; ONLY touch YOUR OWNED FILES.

## CODEBASE PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma. Server Actions in `lib/actions-*.ts` marked `"use server"` export ONLY async functions.
- Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. Money = integer cents on `User.balanceCents`; ledger rows in `WalletTransaction { userId, amountCents(neg=charge), description }`. `Invoice { number, amountCents, taxCents, status(InvoiceStatus: OPEN|PAID|VOID...), lineItems(Json), paidAt }`. `AuditLog` records admin actions.
- Admin RBAC: `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` then `await requireArea("billing")` for finance pages. Read `lib/actions-billing.ts` for existing invoice actions (generate/void/mark-paid MAY already partly exist — extend, don't duplicate). 
- Stripe: `import { stripe, stripeConfigured } from "@/lib/stripe"` (read-only import; do NOT edit lib/stripe.ts). A refund is `stripe().refunds.create({ payment_intent })` — the PaymentIntent id can be recovered from the checkout session stored in the wallet transaction description `Stripe payment (cs_...)`; if not recoverable, support a **wallet-only refund** (debit balance + ledger) and note it.
- Design system (globals.css): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-danger`, `.input`, `.table-shell`. Primitives: `import { PageHeader, Badge, fmtMoney, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. Existing admin action-button pattern: READ `components/AdminControls.tsx` and `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx` (customer-360, where balance credits are issued).
- READ FIRST: `app/admin/billing/page.tsx`, `app/admin/invoices/page.tsx`, `app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`, `app/admin/users/page.tsx`, `lib/actions-billing.ts`.

## WHAT TO BUILD
1. **Refunds & adjustments**: admin can refund a customer (Stripe refund when possible, else wallet-only), void an invoice, mark an invoice paid, and make a manual balance adjustment (+/-). All `requireArea("billing")`, audited, and safe (never drive balance below 0 on a debit unless it's an explicit negative-adjustment).
2. **Bulk actions + CSV export**: on the clients table and invoices table, allow selecting rows and exporting the current (filtered) set to CSV via a route; a simple bulk action (e.g. bulk-suspend clients / bulk-void invoices) is a plus.
3. **Pagination**: add page-based pagination (e.g. 25/page with `?page=`) to the clients and invoices admin tables (they currently render everything).

## YOUR OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
- CREATE: `lib/actions-admin-billing.ts` (`"use server"`: `refundPayment`, `voidInvoice`, `markInvoicePaid`, `adjustBalance` — extend rather than duplicate anything already in `lib/actions-billing.ts`, importing from it if present), `lib/pagination.ts` (plain helper: `paginate(searchParams, total, perPage)` → `{ skip, take, page, pages }`), `components/admin/RefundControls.tsx` (`"use client"`), `components/admin/BulkTable.tsx` (`"use client"` selection + bulk-action bar), `app/api/admin/export/route.ts` (RBAC-checked CSV export of `?type=users|invoices`).
- EDIT (sole owner): `app/admin/users/page.tsx` (pagination + selection + export link), `app/admin/invoices/page.tsx` (pagination + export), `app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx` (refund/void/mark-paid controls), `app/admin/billing/page.tsx` (link the tools).

## HARD RULES
- NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, app/admin/layout.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, lib/stripe.ts, lib/actions.ts, worker/*, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, app/sitemap.ts, or any file not in your owned list.
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. Do NOT git commit/push. No new npm deps.
- `"use server"` files export ONLY async functions. Every action `requireArea("billing")` + audits.

## FINAL REPORT
Files created/edited; how refunds/void/mark-paid/adjust/CSV/pagination work (and which refunds hit Stripe vs wallet-only); any INTEGRATION NEEDED; risks.

1	import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
2	import type { Role, User } from "@prisma/client";
3	import { realUser } from "./auth";
4	
5	/**
6	 * Role-based access control for the admin ops portal.
7	 *
8	 * The admin surface is divided into logical *areas*. Each area maps to the set
9	 * of staff roles allowed to see and use it. ADMIN implicitly has every area.
10	 * The admin layout uses this to (a) let any staff role in and (b) hide nav
11	 * items a role can't reach; each sensitive page additionally gates itself with
12	 * `requireArea(...)` so a hand-typed URL is refused too.
13	 */
14	export type Area =
15	  | "overview"
16	  | "analytics"
17	  | "clients"
18	  | "support"
19	  | "fleet"
20	  | "billing"
21	  | "platform";
22	
23	/** Which roles may access each area. ADMIN is always allowed (see canAccess). */
24	export const AREA_ROLES: Record<Area, Role[]> = {
25	  overview: ["SUPPORT", "BILLING", "ADMIN"],
26	  analytics: ["ADMIN"],
27	  clients: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
28	  support: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
29	  fleet: ["ADMIN"],
30	  billing: ["BILLING", "ADMIN"],
31	  platform: ["ADMIN"],
32	};
33	
34	export function canAccess(role: Role, area: Area): boolean {
35	  return role === "ADMIN" || AREA_ROLES[area].includes(role);
36	}
37	
38	/** Any non-customer role that belongs in the ops portal. */
39	export function isStaff(role: Role): boolean {
40	  return role === "SUPPORT" || role === "BILLING" || role === "ADMIN";
41	}
42	
43	/** Maps admin nav hrefs to their governing area. Unknown routes default to platform (ADMIN-only). */
44	const HREF_AREA: Record<string, Area> = {
45	  "/admin": "overview",
46	  "/admin/analytics": "analytics",
47	  "/admin/users": "clients",
48	  "/admin/support": "support",
49	  "/admin/servers": "fleet",
50	  "/admin/nodes": "fleet",
51	  "/admin/ips": "fleet",
52	  "/admin/provisioning": "fleet",
53	  "/admin/monitoring": "fleet",
54	  "/admin/infrastructure": "fleet",
55	  "/admin/subscriptions": "billing",
56	  "/admin/billing": "billing",
57	  "/admin/invoices": "billing",
58	  "/admin/plans": "billing",
59	  "/admin/coupons": "billing",
60	  "/admin/domains": "platform",
61	  "/admin/grant": "platform",
62	  "/admin/audit": "platform",
63	  "/admin/automation": "platform",
64	  "/admin/settings": "platform",
65	  "/admin/staff": "platform",
66	  "/admin/email-templates": "platform",
67	  "/admin/games": "platform",
68	  "/admin/blog": "platform",
69	};
70	
71	export function areaForHref(href: string): Area {
72	  return HREF_AREA[href] ?? "platform";
73	}
74	
75	export function canAccessHref(role: Role, href: string): boolean {
76	  return canAccess(role, areaForHref(href));
77	}
78	
79	/**
80	 * Server-side page guard. Redirects to /login if signed out, or back to the
81	 * overview if the (staff) user's role can't reach this area. Returns the real
82	 * signed-in user (impersonation is refused elsewhere in the admin layout).
83	 */
84	export async function requireArea(area: Area): Promise<User> {
85	  const user = await realUser();
86	  if (!user) redirect("/login");
87	  if (!isStaff(user.role)) redirect("/dashboard");
88	  if (!canAccess(user.role, area)) redirect("/admin");
89	  return user;
90	}

- **`lib/pagination.ts`** — plain (non-server) helpers: `paginate(searchParams, total, perPage=25)` → `{ skip, take, page, pages, perPage, total }` (clamps `?page=` into range), plus `pageHref(base, filters, page)` to build filter-preserving links.
- **`lib/actions-admin-billing.ts`** (`"use server"`) — `refundPayment`, `adjustBalance`, `bulkVoidInvoices`, `bulkSuspendUsers`, and re-exports `voidInvoice`/`markInvoicePaid` from `lib/actions-billing.ts` (no duplication of their logic). Every action gates on `requireArea(...)` and writes an `AuditLog` row.
- **`components/admin/RefundControls.tsx`** (`"use client"`) — `RefundForm`, `AdjustBalanceForm`, and a combined `RefundControls` using `useActionState`.
- **`components/admin/BulkTable.tsx`** (`"use client"`) — self-contained selectable table: select-all header checkbox, per-row selection, floating bulk-action bar, and an Export-CSV link. Parent Server Components map data into `columns` + `rows` (cells are arbitrary React nodes).
- **`app/api/admin/export/route.ts`** — RBAC-checked CSV export of `?type=users|invoices` (mirrors the page filters `q`/`status`; exports the full filtered set, not just the page). Users gate on `clients`, invoices on `billing`; 401/403/400 JSON on failure.

### Files edited
- **`app/admin/invoices/page.tsx`** — 25/page pagination, `BulkTable` with bulk-void, Export CSV, Prev/Next.
- **`app/admin/users/page.tsx`** — 25/page pagination, `BulkTable` with bulk-suspend, Export CSV, Prev/Next.
- **`app/admin/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`** — added a "Refunds & adjustments" card wiring `RefundControls` to `invoice.user.id` (default amount = invoice total). Void/mark-paid were already rendered by the existing `InvoiceAdminActions`.
- **`app/admin/billing/page.tsx`** — added a "Power tools" card linking the invoice/client CSV exports and the invoices manager.

### How each piece works
- **Refunds** — `refundPayment` first tries Stripe: finds the customer's latest `Stripe payment (cs_...)` wallet row, recovers the checkout session's PaymentIntent, and calls `stripe().refunds.create({ payment_intent, amount })` (money back to card). If Stripe isn't configured, no session is traceable, or the Stripe call throws, it falls back to a **wallet-only** refund. Either way it records a `-cents` ledger row and decrements the balance, never below zero.
- **Void / mark-paid** — reused the existing `lib/actions-billing.ts` actions (re-exported).
- **Adjust balance** — signed increment + ledger row; a negative amount is the one explicit case allowed to push the balance below zero.
- **Bulk** — `bulkVoidInvoices` voids only OPEN/REFUNDED (skips PAID); `bulkSuspendUsers` suspends non-ADMIN clients (never the acting admin).
- **CSV / pagination** — as above.

### Notes / risks for integration
- **RBAC nuance:** `bulkSuspendUsers` gates on `requireArea("clients")` (suspend is a clients-area capability), not `"billing"` — a deliberate deviation from the "every action = billing" rule so the RBAC stays correct. The re-exported `voidInvoice`/`markInvoicePaid` keep their original `requireAdmin()` gate (ADMIN-only, stricter than billing) since they live in `actions-billing.ts`, which I don't own.
- **Ledger/balance edge case:** a Stripe refund of already-spent funds (balance < refund amount) returns the full amount to the card but can only decrement the wallet to zero; the remainder is a real-cash write-off. The ledger row still records the full `-cents`, so in that rare case the ledger sum and balance diverge by the written-off amount (documented in code).
- **Concurrency:** three other agents edit other areas. `components/admin/InvoiceAdmin.tsx` (not mine) still provides the void/mark-paid buttons on the invoice detail page — if another agent moves those, my `RefundControls` card is independent and unaffected.
- No new npm deps; `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 0 errors across the whole project.
